## Download

- [Download ZIP](https://github.com/balaboom123/awesome-italian-brainrot/archive/refs/heads/main.zip) or open a character page for individual files.
- Large originals are linked from each character page.
- [characters.json](characters.json) contains the full index.

For a smaller clone, skip the older file history:

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/balaboom123/awesome-italian-brainrot.git
```

## Contributing

[Suggest a character](https://github.com/balaboom123/awesome-italian-brainrot/issues/new?template=add-character.yml) or [add audio](https://github.com/balaboom123/awesome-italian-brainrot/issues/new?template=add-audio.yml).

For pull requests, add the files and metadata, then run `python3 scripts/build_readme.py`.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for naming and file limits.
